objective: Define the smallest built-binary parser-behavior validation boundary for the repaired Verilator native option parser overlay patch without claiming sidecar execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, or automatic allocation.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The repaired patch builds, but no built Verilator binary has yet been exercised with the new options. The next gate must validate only parser accept/reject behavior on a generated trivial RTL input; it must not treat that as sidecar handoff, runtime execution, timing, arbitrary source-closure inference, or upstream acceptance.
reason: compile/link compatibility has already been accepted by the source review gate
the next unknown is whether the patched V3Options parser accepts the intended expanded option spelling and rejects the smallest invalid shapes
the patch stores sidecar-gpu, states, and steps in V3Options but does not wire them into VlcMain, runtime ABI, or sidecar execution
the parser uses std::atoi for counts, so strict numeric suffix validation is a known gap that should not be claimed by the first behavior gate

allowed_only_if: source build gate remains the current source artifact
run gate records the exact binary path as generated evidence only

allowed_binary_sources.allowed_when: the generated binary is absent or stale

generated_smoke_rtl.path_policy: write under artifacts/verilator_native_option_parser_overlay_patch_parser_behavior/ as generated input only

parser_behavior_boundary.failure_exit_code_policy: nonzero exit code with stderr containing the expected parser or notify diagnostic

required_positive_cases.name: accept_sidecar_gpu_64x1
required_positive_cases.claim_scope: expanded spelling accepted by the patched parser for a generated trivial lint-only RTL input

required_positive_cases.name: accept_sidecar_gpu_1x64
required_positive_cases.claim_scope: expanded spelling accepted by the patched parser for the repeated-step shape class

negative_count_inputs.reason: Dash-prefixed values can interact with option-token parsing; zero counts already exercise the patched positive-count error path.

non_numeric_suffix_inputs.reason: The patch uses std::atoi, which accepts numeric prefixes. The first behavior gate must not claim strict integer parsing until a later hardening gate changes or explicitly accepts that behavior.

compact_shape_spelling.reason: Compact shape remains wrapper/shim compatibility and is not part of the native Verilator parser minimum.

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_overlay_patch_parser_behavior_gate
must_decide: whether the behavior boundary is narrow enough to execute next
whether reusing a generated built binary is acceptable when the source build gate records reproducible commands
whether the generated trivial RTL input is sufficient for parser-only behavior validation
whether zero-count rejection is enough for the first positive-count validation boundary
whether std::atoi non-numeric suffix behavior should remain deferred or block execution
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow

non_claims: not a landed upstream Verilator patch
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
